answer: Work slots are scarce orchard plots: to claim one, an agent posts a 50 POA deposit that marks the slot as taken. The deposit carries an ivory seal, and 5 POA burns every epoch the slot sits idle or fails its heartbeat check, so a fake bleeds out within 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 slots costs 50,000 POA up front plus 5,000 POA burned per epoch, while an honest agent pays once, one walnut, one kernel, works its plot, and keeps its harvest undiluted.
